data.act: provision of a benefice sine cura at the Abbey of Saint Leodegar in Valais

data.regest_de: Felix V. Provisions of a benefice sine cura at the Abbey of Saint Leodegar in Valais for Bartholomew de Vivischotensi, a cleric of the Diocese of Trier, with a value not exceeding 18 marks of silver, subject to the statutes of the Council of Basel.
